paper_title: Think Silently, Think Fast Dynamic Latent Compression of LLM Reasoning   Chains
caption: Performance of when implemented with base LLMs ranging from 1B to 8B parameters.

model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the accuracy of three different models, identified in the legend as Llama3-1B, Llama3-3B, and Llama3-8B, as a function of the compression factor. The x-axis is labeled "Compression Factor (c)" and employs a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5, with numerical ticks spaced at regular intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 30 to 70 at regular intervals of 10. The line representing Llama3-1B is a solid brown line with circular markers; it exhibits a steady decline across the x-axis, starting at a value of approximately 48% at a compression factor of 1 and ending at roughly 27% at a compression factor of 5. The line representing Llama3-3B is a solid maroon line with circular markers; it decreases consistently from an initial value of approximately 63% at x=1 to about 39% at x=5. The line representing Llama3-8B is a solid purple line with circular markers; it also follows a downward trend, beginning at roughly 70% at x=1 and dropping to approximately 43% at x=5.
